Metadata.title: Mercado Vivo — Shop and sell online
Metadata.description: Multi-vendor marketplace: find products from thousands of stores, compare prices, check seller reputation and get it delivered to your door.

Common.brandHome: Mercado Vivo: go to the home page

Home.heroTitle: Shop thousands of stores in one place
Home.heroSubtitle: Compare prices, check seller reputation and get delivery to your door. If something goes wrong, we back you up.
Home.systemSubtitle: Checked right now against the real API, with no made-up data.
Home.statusUnreachableHint: Start the backend in its own terminal (folder E:\ecommerce): docker compose up -d and then uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload.
Home.roadmapItem2: Phase 2: account, sign-up, verification and addresses
Home.roadmapItem3: Phase 3: catalog, search with filters and autocomplete
Home.roadmapNote: This home page is temporary: Phase 0 only delivers the foundations (languages, theme, layout and error pages).

DesignSystem.title: Design system
DesignSystem.subtitle: Every component and its states, in light and dark mode, at 375 px and 1280 px.
DesignSystem.internalNote: Internal working page: it is not indexed by search engines and is not in the sitemap.

accent.howToChange: To change the accent across the whole site, set data-accent="coral" or data-accent="violeta" on the html element: it is a single line in src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx.
accent.contrastChecked: All three presets pass the automated AA contrast test (text 4.5:1 and graphics 3:1) in light and dark mode.
